why: upstream's `background_agents_working` (965) reads
     `last_non_empty_above_prompt_box`, and on this screen that line is the
     update banner, not the waiting line — so the rule cannot fire. Upstream's
     `background_shell_working` (965) reads the footer for `· N shells ·`, and
     2.1.257's footer spells the same signal `· ← 3 agents ·`. With neither
     firing the pane falls to `live_prompt_box` (950), an explicit visible
     idle, and the tracker turns that into a completed turn while the subagent
     is still running. See manifests/sidecar/claude.toml
     (`sidecar.background_agents_waiting`).
